chunks.text: Hello! I am your American Family Digital Coverage Advisor. I can help you understand your auto and home coverages, deductibles, limits, and bundling discounts. How can I assist you today?

userInput.text: What is Dwelling Coverage A and how is it determined?

chunks.text: Dwelling coverage (Coverage A) pays to repair or rebuild your home's physical structure if it is damaged by a covered peril. The coverage amount is calculated based on the estimated replacement cost to rebuild your home from the ground up, not its real estate market value or purchase price.
